title: MultiScan: Scalable RGBD scanning for 3D environments with articulated objects
summary: An indoor scanning dataset with synchronized RGB-D streams, per-frame camera poses, textured 3D surface meshes, and object- and part-level semantic annotations, including door and door_frame labels.

mechanisms.name: Posed semantic door-surface source
mechanisms.description: Combines RGB-D frames and camera poses with a textured mesh carrying per-face object and part semantics, so a labelled door surface can be rendered into a source view with explicit occlusion handling rather than inferred from a loose 3D envelope.
inputs: per-face object and part semantic labels
mechanisms.limitations: MultiScan is an indoor dataset and its annotations do not by themselves establish a valid L10 source-view admission, exact cross-view door selection, traversability, public access, arrival, user benefit, or safety. Dataset access, label coverage, synchronization, and mesh-to-depth consistency still require materialization checks.
